SELECT 
  fished_date_season,
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(anglers), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 6
GROUP BY fished_date_season, fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy DESC, cls
LIMIT 100

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 2) as avg_temp_c,
  ROUND(MIN(wtmp_c), 2) as min_temp_c,
  ROUND(MAX(wtmp_c), 2) as max_temp_c
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC
LIMIT 35
